description: This file contains the PHP class 'Marketing' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Model.Marketing'. It defines methods for managing marketing entities, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving marketing data, as well as associated reports within an OpenCart administrative system.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: This class manages marketing campaigns and associated reports, allowing CRUD operations and data retrieval for marketing entities in the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addMarketing
methods.description: Inserts a new marketing record into the database with provided data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: editMarketing
methods.description: Updates the specified marketing record in the database with new data.

methods.name: deleteMarketing
methods.description: Deletes the marketing record identified by marketing_id from the database and also deletes related reports.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a marketing record based on marketing_id.

methods.name: getMarketingByCode
methods.description: Fetches a marketing record based on its unique code.

methods.name: getMarketings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing records with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketings
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing records matching optional filters.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all reports associated with a given marketing campaign.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves report data associated with a specific marketing campaign, with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total number of reports for a given marketing campaign.
